review: [Cinq South Section 4 Director] Sinclair is a really good damage dealer and clasher on top of being really fast. His numbers are great, easy to setup and satisfactory to look at, and he can even setup 2 Fragile on enemies before the rest of the team acts, boosting overall team damage. His skill rolls are dependent on his speed, in which he very easily gains and is already extremely fast as an ID. He rolls 11 on S1, 16 on S2, and 17 on S3 without conditionals, but when he massively outspeeds the enemy, his S2 and S3 turns into 22 and 26 respectively, which is a major boost to his damage. He has the issue of having his Poise part of the kit working only in Mirror Dungeon and his passive, Max Speed per Poise Count, being also mostly Mirror Dungeon exclusive. No notable E.G.O. Synergies
